visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds a round, brown plush sponge with a yellow square on top and a stitched smiley face; a bottle is squeezed, releasing thick red liquid in a spiral. The background is a white tiled wall. (2) The scene cuts to a bathtub ledge where multiple packaged food-shaped sponges (toast, hot dog, pancake) and several liquid soap bottles labeled in Japanese are displayed. (3) Chronological close-ups show a hand squeezing strawberry-colored pink liquid onto a toast sponge, golden maple-colored liquid onto a pancake sponge, and dark brown sauce onto a round sponge. (4) A woman is seen sitting in a bathtub filled with dense white foam; she holds the bread sponge near her face and pretends to take a bite. (5) Three food-shaped sponges float amidst thick white bubbles in the tub, followed by a shot of feet submerged in foam and a final shot of the woman holding a hot dog sponge with a funny expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator speaks with high energy and an exaggerated comedic tone over an upbeat, fast-tempo electronic BGM. (2) Plastic rustling sounds accompany the visual of packaged sponges; the voice increases in arousal while describing the novelty of the Japanese products. (3) Distinct squelching and squirt SFX are heard as liquid soap is applied to the sponges, synchronized with the narration's fast speech rate. (4) Splashing water and soft bubble-popping sounds are mixed into the background as the narrator explains the foaming property of the soaps. (5) The narrator ends with a humorous, rising intonation remark about getting hungry after the bath, accompanied by a final rhythmic beat of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Product Intro -> Demonstration -> Usage Context -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a unique and fun Japanese bath product set (food-shaped sponges and 'sauce' soaps) by demonstrating their cute appearance and interactive use, ultimately suggesting viewers purchase them at retailers like Don Don Donki.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator provides specific retail locations (Don Don Donki, pharmacies) where the product can be bought and speaks enthusiastically about its features.
